domain: Classical ready/dead reference instrument, eta,gamma,r in (0,1], same initial readiness r and same eta/gamma across all input-word laws; optical-only preparation retains memory within each word
proof: b-v=eta^2*r=a*eta and w=a*eta*gamma; positivity of a and eta makes the inverse unique within the reference family.
conditioning: For two admissible reference-family points in this box, if each of a,b,v,w differs by at most delta, then |Delta eta|<=40*delta, |Delta r|<=124*delta, |Delta gamma|<=560*delta. These are conservative deterministic pairwise bounds, not uncertainty intervals or guarantees for arbitrary off-model coordinates.
minimality_control: Coordinates a,v,w alone can alias: (eta,gamma,r)=(1/2,1/4,1/4) and (1/4,1/2,1/2) give a=1/8,v=5/32,w=1/64 but b=7/32 versus 3/16. This is a parameter-swap ambiguity within the conditioning box.
failure_boundaries: At r=0 or eta=0 this inverse divides by a=0; additional histories or a separately fixed initial condition are needed
Different initial readiness for different words invalidates the shared-parameter inverse
Exact family identifiability does not identify coherent-memory CP completion or a native source law
Large inverse constants show that the charter's 1/100 discrepancy alone does not imply accurate parameter identification
complete_record_policy: Coordinates are unconditional probabilities of the named full words. No-click outcomes and their probability mass cannot be dropped or renormalized away.
